def: the earth (at large, or partitively a land)
kjv: [idiom] common, country, earth, field, ground, land, [idiom] natins, way, [phrase] wilderness, world.
occ: If there be in the land
her unto me in the earth
I pray thee, through thy country
you up out of the land
over against them, in the land
and of them was the whole earth
any more out of his land
his way into his own land
thereof upon it, and the land
them up out of that land
unto thee out of the land
which shall be in the land
none like him in the earth
none like me in all the earth
like it in all the land
and I will make the land
against you, nor against this land
none like him in the earth
for thyself there in the land
shalt thou be in the earth
themselves to him to the earth
to and fro through the earth
unto me, and to the land
shall not be in this land
all of them in the land
thee up out of the land
we pray thee, through thy land
and thou shalt not cause the land
ourselves to thee to the earth
us up out of the land
